name: – Isabella Lövin – After § 36 – Am 1
title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the Baltic Sea and ways forward
part_text: 36a. Highlights the recent case of the stranded humpback whale, ‘Timmy’; notes that an extensive rescue operation had to rely on private donations and that measures were mostly taken on ad hoc basis; encourages the Commission and the Member States to establish a coordinated emergency response and funding mechanism for whale and dolphin strandings;
